story.title: THE LAGOS RELOCATION // CHATTY COMMERCIAL
story.synopsis: A sharp 28-year-old corporate professional receives a surprise promotion to Head of Marketing in Lagos State, required to resume by Monday. After 16 grueling, frustrating hours scouring scammy apartment sites late into the night, he slams his desk in exhaustion: 'Damn it! It shouldn't be this hard.' Grabbing his car keys, he escapes to an upscale Victoria Island lounge to vent to his friend. His friend smirks with disbelief: 'Oh, really? You still do that?' and introduces him to Chatty on WhatsApp. With an on-screen countdown timer ticking, he types: 'Hey Chatty, I need a 2-bedroom apartment in Lekki Phase 1.' In seconds, verified cards arrive, he previews the unit, books a virtual inspection, and hops onto an instant live video walkthrough with an agent. Over the call, he grins: 'I'll go for this.' Next morning, he packs his bags with total swagger: 'Lagos, here I come.' Outro: 'Finding your next home shouldn't take weeks. It takes seconds. Chat Chatty on WhatsApp at 091... and move in.'

beats.title: Scene 01 // The Executive Promotion
beats.description: High-rise corporate office. Managing Director seated behind executive mahogany desk, sliding official brown envelope across table to Femi. Boss says: 'Congratulations. You have been made Head of Marketing in Lagos State. Prepare to resume on Monday.' Femi grabs letter, stunned and overwhelmed.
beats.narration: When a career-defining promotion lands on your desk on Friday... and you have to resume in Lagos on Monday.

beats.title: Scene 02 // The Apartment Hunt Nightmare & Desk Slam
beats.description: 2:00 AM dark bedroom. Laptop screen glowing blue on tired eyes. Scrolling endlessly through frustrating apartment listing sites, exorbitant fees, and ghost agents. Femi slams his palm onto the wooden desk: 'Damn it!' Coffee mug rattles.
beats.narration: Sixteen hours searching for an apartment. Dead-end listings. Shady agents. It shouldn't be this hard.

beats.title: Scene 03 // The Escape to the Lounge
beats.description: Femi grabs car keys. Cut to upscale Victoria Island lounge with moody ambient magenta and amber lighting. Meets his friend at the booth: 'I'm moving to Lagos. But finding an apartment is killing me.' Friend smirks: 'Oh, really? You still do that?'
beats.narration: In Lagos, you don't fight the old system. You discover the shortcut.

beats.title: Scene 04 // The Chatty WhatsApp Reveal
beats.description: Friend hands phone to Femi. Over-the-shoulder medium shot. A floating WhatsApp card appears on screen. Femi types: 'Hey Chatty, I need a 2-bedroom apartment in Lekki Phase 1.'
beats.narration: Meet Chatty. The AI rental assistant living right inside your WhatsApp.

beats.title: Scene 05 // The 45-Second Virtual Inspection
beats.description: A dynamic countdown timer ticks on screen (00:00:42). Verified apartment cards arrive with video walkthroughs. Femi taps 'View Apartment', then 'Book Virtual Inspection'. Instant live video call connects with a leasing agent walking through a bright, sunlit Lekki flat. Femi grins: 'I'll go for this.'
beats.narration: Instant verified listings. Zero middlemen. Live virtual walkthroughs in under sixty seconds.

beats.title: Scene 06 // Packing Bags & Ready to Roll
beats.description: Warm morning sunlight streaming through curtains. Femi zips up leather duffel bags, throws them over his shoulder, grabs keys with a confident swagger: 'Lagos, here I come.'
beats.narration: Packed, ready, and moving in on your own terms.

beats.title: Scene 07 // The Official Brand Outro
beats.description: Sleek brand outro card with glowing WhatsApp green accents. Clean phone mockup showing confirmed booking badge.
beats.narration: Finding your next home shouldn't take weeks. It takes seconds. Chat Chatty on WhatsApp and move in.
